The two horizontal paper strips are separated from each other, and the two vertical paper strips are separated from each other; each horizontal paper strip intersects perpendicularly with each vertical paper strip, so there are a total of 4 overlapping regions. Reasoning: Each paper strip has length 10 and width 1, so the area of each is 10×1=10. The total area of the four paper strips is 4×10=40. method.method_draft: Use inclusion-exclusion on the four strips. From the image, identify that there are two horizontal strips and two vertical strips; each horizontal strip crosses each vertical strip once, making four perpendicular overlap regions. From the text, read that each strip is a 10 by 1 rectangle, so each strip has area 10. Add the areas of the four strips to get 40, then subtract the four double-counted overlap squares. Since perpendicular strips of width 1 overlap in a 1 by 1 square, each overlap has area 1, so the covered area is 40 - 4 = 36.
